verdict.interpretation: Exploratory conditional fixed-delay exposed-prefix result; the predefined support gate fails. No general superiority, unique locality mediation, or scientific promotion follows.

audit.scope: data/source integrity audit; not rerun fidelity or scientific promotion; retained authority statements require independent authenticity verification

terminal.quota_kind: projected write admission; not instantaneous filesystem quota

integrity.authority_pin_origin: Independently parent-captured originals supplied in the task; not inferred from retained package. Hash checks bind bytes; independent authority provenance remains an external trust boundary.

910075.claim_limit: conditional exposed-fixture comparison; no general or unique-mediation claim

910076.claim_limit: conditional exposed-fixture comparison; no general or unique-mediation claim

registered_decision_thresholds.Fw: Separate assembly/readout acquisition from weights/delays. Fw prediction success does not prove field-learning benefit.
registered_decision_thresholds.memory_baselines: Report H/R return and novel comparisons; no general superiority gate or stationary comparator claim.

novel.ceiling_outcome: acquisition_inconclusive; overall supported gate cannot pass; never alter inputs or thresholds after outcomes

registered_decision_thresholds.overall: Primary return AND secondary return AND stationary preservation AND informative novel acquisition/preservation for each fixture. Missing/incomplete/invalid rows cannot pass.
registered_decision_thresholds.scope: Each fixture separately; both must meet gates. No significance/population claim.

secondary_return.residual_gain_confound: Single analytic steady-state control does not remove all finite-horizon/history-dependent gain explanations.

descriptive_full_row_checks.scope: All allocated return and novel rows; no selection/tuned filtering

comparison_interpretation: On return, L improves over C, but G and Fw exactly match L on every retained probability/native prediction row, so the required superiority to the single lower-gain control fails.
On stationary, L improves Brier and coverage in fixture 910075, but harms Brier in fixture 910076 beyond the allowed 0.02 even though count and coverage conditions pass.

On novel, L meets predefined acquisition and preservation gates with positive actual weight writes. Fw matches L on every retained prediction row, so those predictions do not establish benefit from weight learning.

H has more correct novel predictions and full coverage but worse Brier than L/Fw; R has worse Brier and more abstentions. Comparisons apply only to registered return/novel arms, with no H/R stationary superiority claim.
method: Ran only the pinned base-interpreter verifier with explicit source/freeze/independent authority hashes. Other commands were shell hash/inventory checks and jq retained-data extraction; no model execution or replay. All scoring gates are the frozen gates, not post-outcome selections.
